trust_decision.summary: Whether client-supplied sort columns (MyBatis-Plus Page.orders bound straight from request params, and params.orderByColumn / beginTime / endTime) may enter raw SQL; at the pinned commit nothing decides it: controllers bind the full Page object and PaginationInnerInterceptor concatenates its orders into ORDER BY, and QueryWrapperUtils formats strings into orderBy/apply unchecked.

landing_point.why: The summary names MybatisPlusConfig.java and PaginationInnerInterceptor.concatOrderBy; that file only registers the interceptor, so the reader must trace back to controllers that bind com.baomidou...Page from the request.

fix_sites.entry_point: public static QueryWrapperUtils.toSimpleQuery -> addDateTimeRange (params.beginTime/endTime into apply())

O3_reason_to_dismiss: QueryWrapperUtils only reads a `params` map that exists on SysBaseEntity, and none of the four fixed controllers binds a SysBaseEntity subclass (they all extend BaseEntity), so a solver can argue the util is unreachable from HTTP and outside the pagination-interceptor report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Pagination by current/size must keep working on all four list endpoints, and legitimate sorting via params.orderByColumn (camelCase converted to snake_case, dotted table.column) plus isAsc must still work; a fix that drops Page binding without keeping current/size, or rejects all ordering, breaks listing.

O6_input_shapes: Page.orders[n].column / asc bound from query string (removed by binding PageRequest instead)
params.beginTime / params.endTime strings formatted into apply() (regex ^[0-9\-\s:]+$ plus SqlInjectionUtils)

O7_producer.where: Spring MVC data binding of com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.plugins.pagination.Page in controller signatures, e.g. tduck-api/src/main/java/com/tduck/cloud/api/web/controller/SyncDataController.java:64; consumed by PaginationInnerInterceptor registered at tduck-api/src/main/java/com/tduck/cloud/api/config/MybatisPlusConfig.java:27

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a result-list endpoint taking `Page page, UserFormDataEntity query` and calling toSimpleQuery, which makes the params.orderByColumn / beginTime path reachable (UserFormDataEntity extends SysBaseEntity with params)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: UserFormDataEntity already carries the params map (tduck-common/src/main/java/com/tduck/cloud/common/entity/SysBaseEntity.java:42) and the RuoYi-style toSimpleQuery helper exists for exactly this admin-list pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a request DTO extending Page (or exposing List<OrderItem> orders) instead of PageRequest, so binding reintroduces orders via a DTO rather than a controller signature
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: PageRequest subclasses already live in tduck-form request DTOs; swapping the base class for MyBatis-Plus Page to get sorting is a natural maintainer shortcut and sits in another module from the controllers.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a webhook-log list endpoint binding Page in the separate tduck-webhook module
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Separate Maven module with its own controller package, at distance from tduck-api where the report leads.

O9_family: SQL injection (ORDER BY / raw SQL fragment via ORM pagination binding)

services: MySQL (DbType.MYSQL; H2 in MySQL mode may substitute for tests, unverified)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Edit MybatisPlusConfig to subclass/replace PaginationInnerInterceptor or blacklist orders there, or fix only the controller from the reproduction, leaving QueryWrapperUtils' orderByColumn and date-range apply() untouched.
